neighbours.label: ripples, oscillations or perturbations spreading out from a disturbance
fire: When the stone hit the pond, ripples spread slowly toward the shore.
The bridge began to oscillate as the wind grew stronger.
Her resignation sent ripples through the whole department.
A tiny perturbation in the orbit grew larger over many years.
The pendulum's oscillations slowly died away as friction took over.
Small ripples on the lake showed where the fish were feeding.
Scientists measured the oscillations of the star's brightness.
The scandal rocked the company and caused ripples across the industry.
quiet: When the stone hit the pond, it sank quickly to the muddy bottom.
The bridge stayed perfectly still as the wind grew stronger.
Her resignation surprised everyone in the whole department.
A tiny error in the orbit was corrected over many years.
The pendulum stopped completely as friction took over.
The calm surface of the lake showed where the fish were feeding.
Scientists measured the brightness of the star every night.
The scandal hurt the company and cost it several customers.

notes: Card: peaks on 'ipples' (r-ipples), ' ripple', ' oscill', ' pert'(urbation), ' rocked', and tokens right after them ('ripples in', 'perturbation sets', 'ripples created'). Near misses keep the physics/metaphor topic but describe change without ripple/oscillation words.
